prompt: Which U.S. National Park was the first to be established after the Portland Trail Blazers won their only playoff series with LaMarcus Aldridge on the team?
answer:
The **Gateway Arch National Park** in St. Louis, Missouri.

Portland’s 2014 first-round series win over Houston—its only playoff-series victory while LaMarcus Aldridge was on the roster—ended on **May 2, 2014**. The next U.S. national park established was Gateway Arch National Park, redesignated from Jefferson National Expansion Memorial on **February 22, 2018**.
